name: gh-gemini-review-loop
description: Fast-track Gemini Code Assist PR review loop for Claude Code. Thread-state-aware, severity-filtered, capped at 3 cycles, no CI coupling.

plugins.name: gh-gemini-review-loop
plugins.description: Opinionated Gemini Code Assist PR loop. Filters by severity (only fix high+ by default), never spams (hard 3-cycle cap), auto-resolves outdated and addressed-by-reply threads, posts a live sticky-receipt comment for background visibility.
